atoms.title: Psychological tactics (intimidation, urgency, authority, scarcity)
atoms.objective: Identify the four core psychological pressure tactics in a social-engineering message and explain *why* each one lowers a victim's guard.

atoms.title: Elicitation; malicious links and files
atoms.objective: Describe how elicitation extracts sensitive information through conversation, and you can identify the technical indicators that distinguish a malicious link or file from a legitimate one.

atoms.title: Email, text, and social media attacks
atoms.objective: Identify the distinguishing features of phishing attacks delivered over email, SMS, and social media, and explain how channel-specific trust cues make each delivery method effective.
